content.short: Tokeo is the next generation smart mobile wallet for Cardano and beyond, that's safe, secure and packed with features.
content.description:
Tokeo is the next generation smart mobile wallet for Cardano and beyond, that's safe, secure and packed with features.

Tokeo has focused on enhancing the trading experience through a rich and intuitive mobile app, that not only allows you to send and receive in style, but allows you to swap native tokens, work with your NFTs and also send out invoices for on-chain payments. Everything in one place.

We are here to redefine the wallet experience for Cardano via

Starting with Cardano in the first release, we will quickly move to a Cross-Chain offering that links Tokeo seamlessly with Bitcoin and EVM based chains.Download Tokeo Wallet on iOS - https://apple.co/3ztznht ‍

Our ISPO is live to offer investors a further opportunity to join the Tokeo journey and earn $TOKE rewards.

Find all the info here: https://tokeo.gitbook.io/tokeo/tokeo/ispo ‍ Delegate to TOKE: https://www.gomaestro.org/marketplace/42

Tokeo Bot is a Discord bot designed to track events on the Cardano blockchain. It monitors multiple wallets and sends real-time notifications to the linked Discord account when specific events occur.

Tokeo Bot is safe, secure and only allows you to track your own wallets.

Info on how to get started here: https://tokeo.gitbook.io/tokeo/tokeo/tokeo-bot
